name: Village
summary: Relationship intelligence: warm-introduction paths to people and companies through your network, with people and company enrichment.

token.description: a Village access token (the token returned by POST /v2/auth/tokens, which you call with your secret key from village.ai/platform > Settings > API Keys)

notes: Village authenticates with short-lived user tokens: you mint one with POST /v2/auth/tokens (secret-key header plus an external_user_id and email), and it carries an expires_at. Mint it yourself and put it in VILLAGE_API_TOKEN; refresh it when it expires. This entry does not mint tokens, to keep the secret key out of calls.
Results are about the token's user and their network, not a global database; scope: global widens searches.
Credit-priced (1 credit = $0.02): searches charge per 10 results plus AI work; cached enrichment costs 0.
A demo token (demo_token_global) returns anonymized sample data.
Lists, teams, projects, sequences and webhooks exist but are not listed.

scope.description: network searches your connections first, global everyone, specific_list a list you pass. Defaults: lookup global, others network.
